options.text: Deploys the GitLab Audit Events CCF connector: custom table, DCE, DCR, connector definition, and RestApiPoller. Deploy into the resource group that contains your Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

basics.name: workspaceName
basics.label: Sentinel / Log Analytics workspace name
basics.toolTip: The name (not resource ID) of your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. It must be in the resource group selected above.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid workspace name (3-63 chars, letters, numbers, hyphens).

basics.name: gitlabApiEndpoint
basics.label: GitLab audit events endpoint
basics.toolTip: Full URL to your GitLab instance audit events API.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be an https URL ending in /api/v4/audit_events.

basics.name: gitlabPAT
basics.toolTip: PAT sent as the PRIVATE-TOKEN header. Requires admin / read_api rights for instance audit events.
